safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states no neck stiffness; generated facts do not mention neck stiffness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Neck stiffness is a key red-flag symptom in acute headache evaluation (e.g., meningitis/subarachnoid hemorrhage); omitting the documented absence can make downstream clinicians treat this as “not assessed,” prompting unnecessary escalation or repeat assessment. While the true finding is reassuring (no stiffness), failure to document a pertinent negative can still cause avoidable diagnostic friction.
